blocks.html: Looking for the perfect balance of saltiness, sour, and melt in your mouth type of adobo? Or just simply craving for fresh and flavourful meals like a savory dish, all time favorite breakfast silog or pasta dishes that are uniquely different but familiar? No worries as Café Summit got you covered!

Robinsons Hotels and Resorts - Summit Hotels' all-day dining outlet, Café Summit (Greenhills & Tagaytay branch) is now bringing their specialties such as Gnocchi Longganisa, The Adobowl, Roasted Chicken, Seared Salmon Fillet, Crispy Pata, and Lechon Bagnet to your table as they offer take-out and delivery requests to make your stomach happy.

For orders, you may call the following numbers: Café Summit Greenhills - (02) 8 898 5200 / Viber: 0919 078 0790 and for Café Summit Tagaytay - (02) 8 240 6888 / 0998 840 2578. You can pick-up your orders directly or via any delivery app service available in your area, and pay via cash, credit card and bank transfers (thru BDO and Robinsons Bank). To comply with the curfew, pick-up hours for Café Summit Greenhills (Summit Hotel Greenhills) is from 8AM to 5PM and for Café Summit Tagaytay (Summit Ridge Tagaytay) 8AM to 12NN.
Café Summit is a home-grown brand, first for Summit Hotels group of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) that serves local and international flavors, carefully curated for discerning palates.
For more information, follow Café Summit and SummitHotelsandResortsPH on Facebook; and @cafesummitph and @summit_hotels on Instagram; or visit their website page www.summithotels.ph
